summary: Zion Oil & Gas filed Amendment No. 1 to its prospectus supplement, establishing a Unit Option under its Dividend Reinvestment and Common Stock Purchase Plan. Each unit is priced at $250.00, comprising common stock plus warrants to purchase 75 shares at $0.75 per share. The option period runs August 12, 2026 to September 10, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising disclosure under an existing shelf program, not a special situation. Watch for the unit purchase date price determination and warrant exercisability beginning October 12, 2026.
